contract: Ordinary executable evaluator and publisher checkout use exact provider workflow-definition SHA from default-branch workflow_run context, independently of triggering candidate head and PR comparison base.
Candidate material is checked out only in its isolated run-owned path.
Graph validator rejects PR comparison base or candidate head as executable authority for the ordinary finalizer.
Existing provider current-main/evaluator identity checks remain fail-closed; this slice grants no nondefault merge or certification authority.
Queued or moved workflow-source identity must pass existing provider authentication; no fallback to feature source.
remaining: Full bound comparison support in provider finalizer identity and independently installed compatibility remain blocked until complete consumer qualification.
